Header.value: Does the state chain below correctly and completely represent the persona's '$slot' history as stated in the raw session log?

Check all four: (1) every anchor sentence really appears in the log; (2) each DATE matches the date of the session containing its anchor; (3) each VALUE matches what its anchor sentence says; (4) no state change stated in the log is missing from the chain.
If 'Has errors' or 'Unsure': say which row(s) and what is wrong (e.g., 'row #2 date mismatch', 'a change around 1995 is missing', 'row #3 anchor not found in log')
